narration: The same A I can help you... or fool you. What’s the difference?
visual: Split-screen green/coral; central AI disk turns; question lands at 2.5s.

narration: Explain this idea. Help me practise. Draft a message. Useful.
visual: Three task tiles enter at 0.7, 2.7 and 4.7 seconds.

narration: But sounding confident doesn’t make it right. A I can invent facts, sources, and details that seem real.
visual: Confident answer card; red verification stamp arrives at 3.5s; source chip at 6s.

narration: Even a familiar voice can be faked. Verify urgent requests through another channel.
visual: Stylised incoming-call waveform; warning appears at 3s; call-back cue at 4.6s.

narration: Before sharing a password or private document, pause. Check what you’re sending.
visual: Document moves toward input boundary, stops at 2.5s; lock and pause mark at 4s.

narration: Let A I suggest. You check the original source. Then you decide.
visual: Three steps illuminate in sequence at 0.5, 2.6 and 5.2 seconds.

narration: Friend or devil? It’s a powerful tool. Don’t hand it the steering wheel.
visual: Steering wheel illustration draws in, restrained turn; emphasis switches at 3s.

narration: Would you trust A I with an important decision? Where would you draw the line?
visual: Friend/devil choice tiles; comment prompt at 2.5s; final frame holds for at least one second.
